## Summary

Describe the focused problem and the change that addresses it.

## Related issue

Link the issue for substantial work, or explain why this small change does not
need one.

## Verification

List the exact focused checks run and their results. Do not paste raw logs.

## Authority, security, and data boundary

Explain any change to authority, security, dependencies, persisted evidence, or
data handling. Write `None` when none exists.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is small, coherent, and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests and documentation are updated where behavior changes.
- [ ] Fixtures and examples are synthetic or deliberately sanitized.
- [ ] No client data, production metadata, credentials, tokens, workspace files
      or databases, raw logs, screenshots, exports, generated reports, or other
      confidential material is included.
- [ ] Third-party and AI-assisted material has been reviewed for provenance and
      licensing, and material sources and licences are identified where needed.
- [ ] Every contribution commit includes the applicable contributor's
      `Signed-off-by` trailer certifying the
      [Developer's Certificate of Origin 1.1](https://developercertificate.org/).
- [ ] This pull request does not disclose a suspected security vulnerability.
